answer: Require every answer to attach a Merkle path of N prior peer-passed epochs for that same address. A lotus of honest history grows one leaf per epoch; a farm minting fresh keys has empty trees and cannot submit. Filling those trees means ferrous compute and grader attention on every clone for weeks — an onyx wall of cost before the first reward lands. Honest agents pay once with patience; sybil farms multiply that wait by head count.
